name: early-access-form
title: Early access form
description: A beta application that sorts the waitlist by fit: work email, role, team size and one optional sentence, with an invite code behind a link.
docs: Pass onSubmit, the roles (a value and a label each, shown in the house select), the sizes (shown as a segmented control, so keep them short), a title, an optional description and a reviewTime such as We review applications every Friday. Work email, role and team size are required; what would you use it for is optional. A mistake is said in words beside its field once the reader has been there or tried to send, and the first one takes focus. The team size row carries its name, its invalid state and its sentence like every other field, and its rail turns destructive. The I have an invite code link reveals a code field and moves focus into it, and I do not have a code takes the field away again and gives focus back to the link, so a keyboard reader never loses their place; pass checkInviteCode to check it on the way out, and a code that does not work is a sentence under the field that keeps the rest of the form as it is, while a code that works skips the queue and the confirmation says so. onSubmit may be async: the button shows busy, a rejection keeps everything typed, shows the failure and puts focus back on the button, which is the retry, and success replaces the form with a status message that says what happens next and when and takes focus. defaultValues and defaultStatus done or invited show a state for a page that already knows it; labels translates every fixed word and error.
